headlines.text: Back on this day in 2023, gold changed shoulders as the ROH Pure Title found a new champion as Wheeler Yuta vs. Katsuyori Shibata battled it out, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.73 ? ending the champion's reign at 2 defenses. Yuta exploited a distracted referee with a low blow and DDT to dethrone Shibata and become a three-time ROH Pure Champion, in what turned out to be Shibata's final AEW title reign before an extended sabbatical.
Turning the clock back to 2020: Fenix & PAC made a statement, debuting in the main event as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.06 ? a solid showing.

Rewind to 2022, when FTR vs. Top Flight clashed for the ROH World Tag Team Titles, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.98. For Top Flight, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. Every title match carries a little extra weight, and this one was no exception.

secondaries.text: Looking back to 2022, when Anthony Henry laced up for their first AEW match against Darby Allin, appearing on Rampage, rated 5.52.
That Saturday in 2023, Brody King vs. Eddie Kingston met in a Continental Classic League Match, in the night's main event on Collision, rated 7.70 ? a match that delivered.
Flash back to 2022, when The Butcher and The Blade & Rush wasted no time making an impression, debuting right in the main event as a team, appearing on Rampage, rated 5.11.
